name: code-skills
description: Engineering-domain skills. One so far: code-decomposer (decompose, design, and grade a unit of code on the SPEC x EXECUTION axes — is it the right code, and does it provably run, here — scored separately so a plausible implementation can't hide a broken one nor a green test suite hide the wrong behavior; with a self-tested execution harness, a test-vacuity linter that attacks the 'green but wrong' quadrant, a mutation + adversarial-spec-probe doctrine, and unit-family playbooks). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
